description: Singapore public holidays in 2026, including the Mondays that become public holidays under s 4(2) of the Holidays Act 1998 when a holiday falls on a Sunday.

rule.title: Public holidays 2026

source.instrument: Holidays Act 1998 (Schedule and s 4(2)); Ministry of Manpower list

rule.explanation: Dates from MOM's published 2026 list. When a holiday falls on a Sunday, the next day (not itself a public holiday) is also a public holiday under s 4(2) of the Holidays Act 1998.
caveats: If the President declares an additional holiday (for example, Polling Day), add it here.
